claims.claim: After 3.Nxe5 Nxe4, 4.Qe2! is the answer; 4…Nf6?? loses the queen to 5.Nc6+, and 4…Qe7 is the move
claims.detail: Stockfish's reply to 3…Nxe4 is d1e2; 4…Nf6 gives away 37.8 (blunder) and 5.Nc6+ is a discovered check; Stockfish's defence is d8e7

claims.claim: With an early …Nd7, Bc4 puts pressure on f7 and some natural moves already lose
claims.detail: after 4.Bc4 — Be7: 19.5 (blunder), Ngf6: 13.8 (mistake), h6: 5.7 (inaccuracy), c6: 0.9 (best/excellent)

claims.claim: 5.Qe2 Ngf6?? 6.Nd6 is checkmate

claims.claim: After c4 the knight usually goes to b6

claims.claim: After 4…dxc4, 5.a4 stops …b5
claims.detail: 5.a4 gives away 0.0 (best/excellent)

claims.claim: After …Bxc3 White gets doubled c-pawns and the bishop pair

claims.claim: 4.Nxe5? is a mistake, 5.Nxf7?? a blunder, and after 4.Nxd4 White is clearly better
